title: Beyond English-Centric Training: How Reinforcement Learning Improves Cross-Lingual Reasoning in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on cross-lingual reasoning performance in mathematical, scientific, and commonsense tasks. It does not evaluate religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
